title: Kagamine Len — Let Individuality Shine〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haruka seemed to be feeling much better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. I'm glad we could help her, even just a little.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, so... Remember how Haruka was thinking about what makes MORE MORE JUMP! special?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I realized it can be really hard for someone to see why they're unique or why people are drawn to them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think it is that makes me special?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well, you're like Prince Charming.
It's the way you sparkle and shine. Take for instance...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Everyone!
Thanks for coming to see my solo show today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Knowing that you're all smiling and cheering for me fills my heart with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This special moment is just for you and me, everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're like a prince with a charming smile. That's what I think makes you special, Len!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Normally, you're very cool and pleasant, but you really shine whenever you take the stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Also, you're always so thoughtful!
Remember that show you did the other day?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks for cheering so loudly, everyone!
How are you guys doing? I hope you're not too tired.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I mean, you guys have sorta been bouncing off the walls.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, before we move to our next song, let's all take a seat and chat for a bit.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're always looking out for your audience.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's the sort of kindness that really makes you princely!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Remember that time a little while back when you danced with Rin? That ballroom-inspired choreography...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll take the lead, so just entrust everything to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The way you gracefully offered her your hand felt like something out of a fairytale!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think that was your best display of chivalry to date. I mean, the way your fans cheered was deafening!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really appreciate all your kind words, but I don't know how much more I can handle.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh no... I-I'm really sorry!
I kind of just got into it...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I can't help but feel embarrassed after being showered with so much praise.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I want to make the most of what you believe makes me special...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, not just that.
I'm going to do my best to shine even brighter!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful! I'll certainly be looking forward to that!
